name: Gong Sheng
current_role: Standing Executive Director and President, Jiangsu Shagang Group (Zhangjiagang)
profile: Gong Sheng is the long-serving president of Jiangsu Shagang Group, China's largest private steelmaker (about 40m tonnes of crude steel in 2023). He took over as president from founder Shen Wenrong in 2011, after serving as vice president, and holds a shareholding in the group. He still runs operations under chairman Shen Bin.
interesting_fact: He succeeded founder Shen Wenrong as Shagang's president in 2011 and has run day-to-day operations of China's biggest private steelmaker for more than a decade.
deep_cut_fact: In October 2026 he personally led a site visit to Shagang's Huaigang special-steel subsidiary, which reflects his hands-on, plant-floor management style.
notes: Low public profile, and there is almost no personal biography online. The best route is the Shagang Group board office (集团董事局 常委办公室) email. Listed arm: Jiangsu Shagang Co (002075.SZ).

name: Chen Qiming
current_role: Shareholder associated with SF Express / SF Holding (002352.SZ); no executive title found
profile: Chen Qiming is one of nine SF Express-linked individuals on the 2020 Hurun Global/China Rich List, with an estimated RMB 3.1bn (rank 1,705). The listing implies an early or indirect stake in SF Holding, the delivery giant founded by Wang Wei. I found no published biography or SF board or management role.
interesting_fact: He was one of nine SF-linked people on the 2020 Hurun list, a year in which SF's rising share price added five new SF billionaires-by-yuan.
notes: He is not among SF Holding's directors, supervisors or senior management in the filings I checked. He is probably an early partner or indirect shareholder. Identity details are thin. The only route is via SF Holding IR, which may not forward.

name: Sudhir Valia
current_role: Former director of Sun Pharmaceutical Industries; retired from the board at the 2025 AGM. Private investor and businessman.
profile: Sudhir V. Valia is a Mumbai chartered accountant and the brother-in-law of Sun Pharma founder Dilip Shanghvi. He is part of Sun Pharma's promoter group and held about 0.6% of the company in 2025. He was whole-time director from 2005 to 2019, running finance, commercial, operations, projects and quality control, then served as a non-executive director until he chose not to seek re-election in 2025.
interesting_fact: As Sun Pharma's whole-time director from February 2005, he oversaw finance, operations, projects and quality control during the decade it grew into India's largest drugmaker. He also sat on the board of Taro Pharmaceutical (Israel) from 2010.
deep_cut_fact: He trained as a chartered accountant (B.Com, University of Mumbai) and built more than four decades of taxation and finance experience before becoming the finance architect behind his brother-in-law's pharma group.
notes: He left the Sun Pharma board at the 2025 AGM, so a Sun Pharma contact is a weak route. He has no public social media. In 2019 he moved to a non-executive role after whistleblower complaints about loans to firms linked to him, so avoid that topic. Keep any approach low-key.

name: Li Lei
current_role: Co-founder and former CEO (2018-19) and vice chairman of Qutoutiao Inc.; no current public role found
profile: Li Lei co-founded Qutoutiao, the Shanghai 'pay-to-read' news-aggregator app, with Eric Tan Sixiao. He served as CEO from August 2018, when it listed on Nasdaq, until May 2019, and then as vice chairman. He held about 7.6% of the company (15.6% of the votes) in 2022, before Qutoutiao was delisted in 2023.
interesting_fact: He led Qutoutiao through its September 2018 Nasdaq IPO, which came about two years after launch. The app grew fast by paying users in coins to read and share articles, aimed at lower-tier cities.
deep_cut_fact: He studied while building the business, earning an associate degree in law (2014) and a bachelor's in law (2017) from the Open University of China. Earlier he was director of advertising solutions at Shanda's ad subsidiary, Shanghai Shengyue (2010-13).
notes: Qutoutiao was delisted from Nasdaq in 2023, and I found no current company or personal contact. He is low-profile since stepping down as CEO in 2019. Don't confuse him with other people named Li Lei (e.g. former ByteDance AI Lab head Lei Li).

name: Qi Xuexia
current_role: Director and Assistant to the President, Shenzhen Riland Industry Co. (瑞凌股份, 300154.SZ)
profile: Qi Xuexia (born 1975, master's degree) is a co-founder-generation director of Riland, a Shenzhen maker of inverter welding and cutting machines controlled by chairman and president Qiu Guang. Hurun lists the wealth jointly with Qiu. She was sales director of the predecessor company, Shenzhen Riland Industrial, and now also runs Riland International and several investment vehicles.
interesting_fact: Riland is one of China's leading inverter-welding-equipment brands, with a European subsidiary (Riland Europe) and recent units in intelligent welding and industrial investment.
deep_cut_fact: She started on the commercial side as sales director of Shenzhen Riland Industrial, before the 2010 ChiNext listing. She now also sits on the board of Shenzhen HIT (Harbin Institute of Technology) Sci-Tech Innovation Industry Development Co. and is a director of Shenzhen Hengte Gene.
notes: Wealth is shared with Qiu Guang (controller, chairman and president). Board secretary: Kong Liang; securities representative: Xiong Xiaoju. Both are reachable via the IR email. Very low media profile.

name: 2016 Organo 10-Year Grat U/a/d September 30 2016 Gn
current_role: Not a person. This is the GN 2016 Organo 10-Year GRAT, a trust of Glenn H. Nussdorf, director of Organogenesis Holdings (ORGO) since 2003 and CEO of Quality King Distributors.
profile: This SEC filer is a grantor retained annuity trust tied to Glenn H. Nussdorf ('GN'), who is its trustee. The trust is part of Organogenesis's controlling stockholder group. Nussdorf has been CEO of Long Island-based Quality King Distributors (health and beauty products and prescription drugs) since 1999. He has sat on Organogenesis's board since 2003 and is also a major Perfumania shareholder.
interesting_fact: Nussdorf and fellow controlling holders turned Organogenesis, the Canton, MA regenerative-medicine pioneer behind Apligraf (the first FDA-approved bioengineered living-cell skin product), into a Nasdaq company via a 2018 SPAC merger.
deep_cut_fact: He worked his way up inside Quality King: senior vice president from 1994 to 1996, COO from 1997 to 1998, and CEO from 1999, overseeing its QK Healthcare prescription-drug distribution arm.
notes: The SEC 'name' is a trust: GN 2016 Organo 10-Year GRAT, with Glenn Nussdorf as trustee (13D/A). The person behind it is Glenn H. Nussdorf. Organogenesis IR is run by ICR Healthcare. The recent press contact was Cheston Turbyfill (cturbyfill@organo.com) per Oct 2026 releases. He keeps a very low public profile.

name: Wang Haihong
current_role: Unknown. Listed by Hurun (2018-20) as sharing Richinfo (彩讯股份, 300634.SZ) wealth with chairman Yang Liangzhi, but not named in Richinfo's filings
profile: Hurun China listed Wang Haihong (王海宏) from 2018 to 2020 as sharing a fortune of about $400m tied to Richinfo, the Shenzhen mobile-email and enterprise-software company controlled by chairman Yang Liangzhi. I could not find this name among Richinfo's directors, officers or top-10 shareholders in its 2018, 2021, 2024 or 2025 annual reports, so the link is unverified.
notes: Identity unconfirmed. The name is absent from Richinfo's annual reports. He may be a relative or an indirect holder via a partnership, or Hurun may have mislabelled the entry. Richinfo's controllers are Yang Liangzhi (MIT MBA, chairman) and Zeng Zhijun (acting in concert). The Richinfo board-office email is the only route.

name: Andrew Bliss
current_role: Director, Bullish (NYSE: BLSH), where he chairs the nominating and governance committee; Founder and MD, Bliss Capital Limited (Cayman Islands)
profile: Andrew C. Bliss (about 39) was on the founding team of block.one, the EOS blockchain developer, where he served as CFO, then COO, then Chief Strategy Officer. He is also a founding-team member and director of Bullish, the institutional crypto exchange that listed on the NYSE in August 2025, and owns about 3.3% of it. He now runs Bliss Capital, a Cayman-based tech investment firm.
interesting_fact: He has been on the founding team of two big crypto ventures: block.one, which ran one of the largest token sales ever for EOS, and Bullish, the exchange spun out of it that listed on the NYSE in 2025.
deep_cut_fact: Before crypto he worked on finance, operations and compliance at avionics maker Rockwell Collins (Cedar Rapids, Iowa) across the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific. He was then CFO of ii5, a Hong Kong property-software start-up. He holds both a BBA in finance and an MBA from the University of Iowa.
notes: He is Cayman-based and keeps a low public profile. I found no verified personal social accounts or a Bliss Capital website. Bullish IR is the best route. Possible podcast angle: crypto exchange infrastructure and digital-asset market structure.

name: Yu Xindong
current_role: Chairman, TKD Science and Technology Co. (泰晶科技, 603738.SH), Suizhou, Hubei
profile: Yu Xindong is founder and chairman of TKD Science and Technology, a Hubei-based maker of quartz crystal resonators and oscillators (frequency-control components) used in phones, IoT, automotive and communications gear. He ran the predecessor Shenzhen Taijing Industrial from 2004, has chaired TKD since 2005 and took it public in Shanghai in 2016. He is also a council member of the China Electronic Components Association's piezoelectric crystal branch.
interesting_fact: TKD is one of China's leading domestic suppliers of tuning-fork and SMD quartz crystals, a component category long dominated by Japanese makers. Its industrial park is in Suizhou, Hubei.
deep_cut_fact: He was one of the main drafters of China's national electronics industry standard for tuning-fork quartz crystal units (SJ/T10015-2013, 10kHz-200kHz test methods). He also earned a PhD in management science and engineering from Wuhan University of Technology in 2017, three decades after graduating from its mechanical department in 1988.
notes: Hurun's 'Tkd' is TKD Science and Technology (泰晶科技). He also holds a Tsinghua MBA (2007). Securities representative: Zhu Liuyan. The company board-office email is the best route.
